crons.//: Daily, because Hobby REJECTS anything more frequent at deploy time ('Hobby accounts are limited to daily cron jobs'). Vercel also only guarantees the hour, not the minute (±59 min). See docs/runbook.md §3 — on Hobby this alone cannot keep the 'code sous 72 heures' promise, so an external hourly scheduler hits the same endpoint. Switch this to '0 * * * *' if the project moves to Pro, and drop the external scheduler.
